title: A Busy Morning
description: A mother gets her family ready for the day.
instructions: Read the text about a busy morning, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: Mrs Davis gets up at six o'clock every morning. She makes breakfast for her family. She cooks eggs and toast.
At half past six, she wakes up her two sons. The boys wash their faces and put on their school clothes. They eat breakfast quickly.
At seven o'clock, Mrs Davis walks the boys to school. Then she takes the bus to work. She is tired, but she loves her family.
Before they leave, Mrs Davis makes lunch for the boys. She puts sandwiches, an apple and a bottle of water in each lunch box. She also gives food to the family dog, Rex.
This morning, there was a problem. Her younger son, Ben, could not find his left shoe. Everyone looked for it. At last, Mrs Davis found it under the sofa. Rex was asleep next to it!

The walk to school takes fifteen minutes. On the way, the boys talk about their friends and their lessons. Mrs Davis holds an umbrella because it often rains in the morning. At the school gate, she kisses the boys goodbye.

Then Mrs Davis waits at the bus stop. This morning, the bus was ten minutes late. She was worried, but she got to work at eight o'clock, just in time. She sat down at her desk and smiled. Her busy morning was over.
